observations: Calc package contains only 8 Tedds wood shear wall sheets (SW1-SW3, 1SW1-1SW3, 2SW1, 2SW2). No calcs for any scheduled beam (B101-B104 3-ply 1¾x11⅞ LVL, B201 (2) 2x12, B301-B303 2-ply LVL, RB1 3-ply 1¾x14 LVL), HSS 6X6X14" posts, 6x6 carport posts, footings F1-F4, joists/rafters, hold-downs/anchors, or any seismic/wind base-shear report.
Drawing S-4 shows shear walls 2SW3 and 2SW4 that have no calculation sheet.

Sheathing mismatch: all wall schedules call 2x6 DF-L No.2 @16" w/ 7/16" OSB; every calc uses 5/16'' Structural I OSB with 6d common @ 4'' (vs1 = 600 lb/ft, vw1 = 840 lb/ft, Ga1 = 18 kips/in) on side 1 plus 5/8'' x 4' gypsum with 0.120'' nails 4''/7'' (vs2 = vw2 = 400 lb/ft, Ga2 = 9.5 kips/in) on side 2, combined vsc = 800 lb/ft, vwc = 840 lb/ft. No nailing/hold-down schedule is printed although notes say 'PER SHEAR WALL SCHEDULE'.

Edition mismatch: drawings cite 2025 CRC/CBGSC (plus 'latest adopted edition of the UBC', 2019 CALGREEN disclaimer, 'Arizona Green Building Code'); calcs use NDS2018 + IBC 2018 cl.1605.3.1 load combinations.

Lateral loads look like placeholders: every wall has W = 135 lbs, Eq = 40 lbs, D = 135 lb/ft, Lf = 140 lb/ft, Lr = 180 lb/ft, SDS = 1, Ie = 1.25, Cdδ = 4 regardless of wall length/height/story (same values as the 16619 Orchard set). Utilizations are ≤ 0.03 everywhere; chord T is negative (no uplift) on all walls; hold-down forces T3/T4 printed as negative on 1SW3 (-0.031 kips) and 2SW2 (-0.022 kips).
Seismic importance factor Ie = 1.25 used for a single-family residence (Risk Category II would be Ie = 1.0).
Panel heights 17 ft (1SW1-1SW3) and 14.33 ft (2SW1, 2SW2) vs 9 ft (SW1-SW3) — not verifiable against the drawings (no wall heights printed in extracted text).

Foundation schedule internally inconsistent: F1 printed as 24"X24"X12" in schedule but 24"X24"X18" in S-1.1 SIZE column and plan callouts; F2 is listed both as an existing 8"X16" CMU wall and a new 18"W X 10"D footing; schedule on S-1 jumps F1, F2, F4 (F3 15"X18" only on S-1.1).
Dates inconsistent: structural sheets 'DATE ISSUED 2/2/2026', architectural 5/9/2026, calc report 'DATE: JUNE-18-2026', Tedds headers 6/19/2026.
